LESSON: CLEANING WASTE DISPOSAL FACILITIES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTISES
Topic 3.1: Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities, part of HYGIENE PRACTISES in Grade 9 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How does cleaning waste disposal facilities promote hygiene?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the importance of cleaning waste disposal facilities

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. clean waste disposal facilities at the household level

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. adopt the use of clean waste disposal facilities at the household level. Learners are guided to: • discuss and share experiences on the importance of cleaning waste disposal facilities such as waste bins, sinks, and open drains. • clean waste disposal facilities such as dust bins, sinks, and open drains. • maintaining clean waste disposal facilities at the household level using improvised resources. How does cleaning waste disposal facilities promote hygiene?

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. explain the importance of cleaning waste disposal facilities

   Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. clean waste disposal facilities at the household level

C. adopt the use of clean waste disposal facilities at the household level. Learners are guided to: • discuss and share experiences on the importance of cleaning waste disposal facilities such as waste bins, sinks, and open drains. • clean waste disposal facilities such as dust bins, sinks, and open drains. • maintaining clean waste disposal facilities at the household level using improvised resources. How does cleaning waste disposal facilities promote hygiene?

   Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Critical thinking and Problem-solving: reflection skills as learners assess their success in cleaning waste disposal facilities.

Values

Responsibility: taking safety precautions as learners clean waste disposal facilities.
